title: Accurate and Data-Efficient Toxicity Prediction when Annotators Disagree

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the impact of annotator race (both explicit and imputed from survey responses) as an input feature to predict individual toxicity ratings and capture differing demographic perspectives.
Evaluating the impact of annotator gender (both explicit and imputed from survey responses) as an input feature to predict individual toxicity ratings and capture differing demographic perspectives.
Evaluating the impact of the annotator's self-reported importance of religion as an input feature to predict individual variations in subjective toxicity ratings.
Evaluating the impact of annotator LGBT status as an input feature to predict individual variations in subjective toxicity ratings.
Evaluating the impact of annotator education level as an input feature to predict individual variations in subjective toxicity ratings.
Evaluating the impact of annotator political stance as an input feature to predict individual variations in subjective toxicity ratings.
